Note: If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags with the Tiles
version of Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup, scroll down to the end of this file.


Tiles specific commands
-----------------------

There are several different ways to interact with your environment, both
by typing the command keys, and by using the mouse.

Of notable interest is the clickable tab area to the right of the screen
that allows easy access to e.g. inventory, spells, or common commands.

Depending on your screen resolution, one of more of these panels may be
open at any time, though you can temporarily exchange the inventory view
with another type of tiled panel by clicking on the tab icons.

You can customize the priority of the control panels by modifying the
tile_layout_priority option in init.txt in the settings directory.


Movement
--------

You can move by using the arrow keys, the vi-keys, or the number pad.
(For the latter try both Numlock on and off.)

Numpad:   7 8 9     vi-keys:   y k u
           \|/                  \|/
          4-.-6                h-.-l
           /|\                  /|\
          1 2 3                b j n


To run several steps into the same direction, press Shift along with these
keys.

You can also move by clicking somewhere on the map or minimap with your
mouse. If the square is reachable from your current position and there are
no hostile monsters in sight, you will automatically travel there. If there
are hostile monsters in sight, you will only take a single step at a time.

For automatic exploration, you can either type the 'o' command or you can
click on the corresponding tile in the command panel to the right of your
screen. Like mouseclick travel, these will refuse to work if there are
hostile monsters in sight.


Getting information
-------------------

Doing a right-click with your mouse on any feature, monster or item on the
main map or in the tiled control panels will display the description of
said feature, monster or item on a separate screen.

A simple mouseover will usually display the same description, or as much of
it as can fit, in the message area.

Similarly, letting your mouse rest for a while on a feature, monster or
item will usually display a "tool tip" of applicable commands.


Attacking monsters
------------------

You can attack a monster in melee by moving into it with the movement keys
or by clicking on it with your mouse.

For ranged attacks (including spells and wands), mouse over the monsters
and wait for the tool tip to appear. Alternatively, you can cast spells by
clicking on the spell tiles in the spell panel, or fire ammunition or
evoke wands by clicking on them in the inventory panel.

In the command panel, you'll also find a tile described as "Autofight",
which, if clicked, will attack an adjacent monster in melee, or if there is
no adjacent monster, take one step in the direction of the closest monster.


Item usage
----------

The easiest way to use items is by clicking on them in the inventory panel.
The mouseover tool tip will tell you what a mouseclick will do, and also
the corresponding command key to execute the same action.
As an alternative, you can also use an item by selecting it in the inventory
('i' command) and then pressing the appropriate key in the action prompt.

To pick up items on the ground, you can either click on them one by one in
the floor section of the inventory panel, or you can click on the player
tile and pull up a menu of selectable items instead. In the latter case,
'Enter' will confirm your selection and start pick up.

Dropping items works similarly, either by clicking on single items in the
inventory panel, or by typing the 'd' command and then selecting items
from a menu.


Interacting with the dungeon
----------------------------

Again, doing a mouseover on features (such as staircases or doors) in the
main map will tell you how to interact with them.


Character status
----------------

Doing a right-click on the player tile will display a character overview
screen listing equipment, resistances and stats.

More detailed screens on specific aspects of your characters can be
accessed by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the command panel.


Character appearance
--------------------

You can change your character's appearance with the Doll Editor, accessed with
the '-' command. Use 'm' to switch between modes: Equip, where your appearance
dynamically updates based on the items you equip; Default, a sprite based on
your character’s race and background; and Custom, which allows you to fully
customize each part of your character's look. Use the number keys to switch
between custom doll slots and the arrow keys to modify the different parts of
each custom sprite. Save your changes and selection with 'Ctrl-S'.



If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags...
--------------------------------------------------------

Crawl renders its graphics using OpenGL and SDL. However, it needs hardware
acceleration to not run slowly. If you are on Windows, make sure to update
your graphics card driver. If you are on Linux, be sure that you are using
DRI.

It has been tested successfully with cards as old as the i865. Unfortunately,
it has been known to be slow on the i810 and there is little to be done in
that case but to run the console version instead or switch to a different
machine.

You can try tweaking a number of options in init.txt in the settings
directory to see whether performance improves:

travel_delay = -1
    This setting suppresses redrawing until travelling is finished or
    interrupted.

tile_update_rate = 1000
    By default, the screen gets redrawn at least every 1000 milliseconds,
    more often if you take actions that change the display. You could try
    cranking up this value, though this may lead to updating taking too long.

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    While running and resting the screen is redrawn every 17 milliseconds.
    If Crawl is slow while running or resting, increase this number.

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    Deactivating the tooltips means there's less stuff to draw every time.

clear_map = false
    Not having to redraw remembered monsters outside your line of sight
    takes some load off the redrawing routines.

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    The larger the map area the more cells there are to redraw each turn.
    If you've got a large display showing way more than the necessary 17x17
    grids of the map, you could try specifying a lower resolution.

图形版专用操作
--------------

你可以用键盘命令或鼠标与周围环境交互。

屏幕右侧可点击的标签页能方便地打开背包、法术或常用命令面板。

根据屏幕分辨率，可能同时显示一个或多个面板。点击标签图标，可以暂时把背包面板
切换为其他图形面板。

修改 settings 目录中 init.txt 的 tile_layout_priority 选项，可以调整控制面板
的优先顺序。


移动
----

可用方向键、vi 按键或数字小键盘移动。小键盘可尝试开启或关闭 Numlock。

小键盘：  7 8 9     vi 按键： y k u
           \|/                \|/
          4-.-6              h-.-l
           /|\                /|\
          1 2 3              b j n

按住 Shift 再按方向键，可以向同一方向连续行走。

也可以用鼠标点击地图或小地图上的位置。如果该位置可以到达，且视野内没有敌对怪
物，就会自动前往。如果视野内有敌对怪物，则每次只会迈出一步。

按 o 或点击右侧命令面板中的自动探索图标，即可自动探索。与点击地图旅行一样，
视野内有敌对怪物时不能使用。


获取信息
--------

右键点击主地图或控制面板上的地形设施、怪物或物品，会打开其说明界面。

将鼠标移到相应位置，通常也会在消息区显示相同说明，或显示消息区容得下的部分。

将鼠标在地形设施、怪物或物品上停留片刻，通常会出现列出适用命令的提示框。


攻击怪物
--------

使用方向键朝怪物移动，或用鼠标点击怪物，即可进行近战攻击。

进行远程攻击（包括法术和魔杖）时，可把鼠标移到怪物上并等待提示框出现。也可以
点击法术面板的法术图标施法，或点击背包面板中的弹药、魔杖进行发射或发动。

命令面板中还有名为 Autofight（自动战斗）的图标。点击它会近战攻击相邻怪物；若
没有相邻怪物，则向最近的怪物迈出一步。


使用物品
--------

最方便的方法是在背包面板中点击物品。悬停提示会说明点击的效果，以及执行相同动
作的键盘命令。

也可以按 i 打开背包，选择物品，再按操作提示中相应的按键。

拾取地上物品时，可以在背包面板的地面区域逐个点击，也可以点击角色图标，打开物
品选择菜单。后者按 Enter 确认选择并开始拾取。

丢弃物品的方式类似：在背包面板中点击单件物品，或按 d 后在菜单中选择物品。


与地牢交互
----------

将鼠标移到主地图上的楼梯、门等地形设施，同样会显示如何与其交互。


角色状态
--------

右键点击角色图标，可以打开角色概览，查看装备、抗性和属性数值。

点击命令面板中的相应图标，可以查看角色各方面的详细信息。


角色外观
--------

按 - 打开角色外观编辑器。按 m 切换模式：Equip（装备）会根据穿戴物品动态更新

Crawl Quick-Start Guide
=======================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


So, you want to start playing Crawl straight away without bothering with the
manual? Read this, the guide to starting Crawl with a minimum of preparation.

I suggest printing it out and following its instructions while playing your
first few games (you can also press `?` twice while playing for a list of
commands). You should also try the tutorial mode; it only takes a few
minutes.

When you get some more time, you can read `crawl_manual.txt` in the docs/
directory for more detailed information.

INTRODUCTION TO CRAWL
---------------------

Crawl is a large and very random game of subterranean exploration in a fantasy
world of magic and frequent violence. Your quest is to travel into the depths
of the Dungeon (which is different each time you play) and retrieve the Orb of
Zot.

Crawl is an RPG of the `rogue-like` type, one of the descendants of Rogue. Its
graphics are simple but highly informative, designed to be understood at a
glance, and control is exercised largely through one-keystroke commands.

STARTING OUT
------------

After starting the program you will be greeted with a message asking for your
name. Don't spend too much time over this, as your first character will **not**
last very long (sorry, but it's true).

Next you are given menus of species and backgrounds from which to choose.
A mountain dwarf, minotaur or troll Fighter is a good bet. Elves are quite
fragile, humans are pretty average at everything, and the weirder species are
mostly too tricky for beginning players. Finally, you may be given a choice of
weapons. I suggest an axe (axes are fun).

Now you are in the game. The game screen has three parts:

 - the Map takes up the upper left part of the screen. In its very centre is
   the `@` sign (or player doll tile) which represents You. The bright parts of
   the Map are the parts you can see, while places which you have visited
   before but cannot currently see are darkened.
 - the Message box is the large part of the screen below the map. It describes
   events as they happen and asks you questions from time to time.
 - the Stats area (to the right of the Map) contains various indicators of
   your health and abilities.

EXPLORING
---------

Try walking around, using either the numeric keypad (try numlock off and on) or
the Rogue (`hjklyubn`) keys. Pressing `o` will activate auto-explore, which will
move until an enemy is seen, or some other notable event (e.g. finding a set of
stairs) occurs.

If you want to know what a certain character on the screen represents, you can
use the `x` (examine) command to get a short description, and then `v` to get
more information. You use the `O`, `C` commands to open or close doors, and the
`<` (up) and `>` (down) commands to climb staircases.

The Dungeon gets more dangerous (but more interesting!) as you go down. If you
get lost you can access a map of the whole level you are on with the `X`
command, which uses the whole screen.

ITEMS
-----

After walking around for a while, you will no doubt come across some items
lying around (you may come across some monsters as well; for help in dealing
with them skip to the Monsters section). You can pick up items with the `g`
(get) or `,` commands and drop them again with `d` (drop), and the `i`
(inventory) command shows you what you're carrying. While examining your
inventory, press any item's key to see more information about it, and to list
available commands.

There are several different types of items:

 - **Weapons**, represented by the `)` sign. Wield them with the `w` (wield)
   command.
 - **Armour** (`[`). Wear it, or take it off, with the `W` (Wear) command.
   Heavier armours give more protection, but may hamper your ability to dodge,
   cast spells, or fire ranged weapons.
 - **Ammunition** (which has the `(` sign). Throw it with `f` and `F` (fire).
 - **Wands** (`/`), **Scrolls** (`?`) and **Potions** (`!`) can be very
   valuable, but have limited uses (scrolls and potions can only be used once
   each, wands contain only a certain number of charges). Wands are e`V`oked,
   scrolls are `r`ead and potions are `q`uaffed. Unfortunately, you won't at
   first know what a scroll or potion does; it will only be described by its
   physical appearance. But once you have used, for example, a potion of curing,
   you will in the future recognise all potions of curing.
 - **Rings** (`=`) and **Amulets** (`"`) provide various mostly-helpful effects.
   They are put on with `P` (put on) and can be removed with `R`.
 - **Money** (`$`) can be used to buy stuff in shops.

There are a few other types of items, but you will discover these as you play.

MONSTERS
--------

You will also run into monsters (most of which are represented by letters of
the alphabet). You can attack a monster by trying to move into the square it
is occupying. Pressing Tab will automatically move toward & attack nearby
monsters.

When you are wounded you lose hit points (displayed near the top of the stats
list); these return gradually over time through the natural process of
healing. If you lose all of your hp you die.

To survive, you will need to develop a few basic tactics:

 - Rest between encounters. The `s`, `.`, delete or keypad-5 commands make you
   rest for one turn, while pressing `5` or Shift-and-keypad-5 make you rest
   for a longer time (you will stop resting when fully healed).
 - Never fight more than one monster if you can help it. Always back into a
   corridor so that they must fight you one-on-one.
 - Consumable items like scrolls and potions won't do you any good when you're
   dead, and most are more effective when used at the start of a tough fight
   than when you're near death. Try identifying some ahead of time by 'wasting'
   one from a stack while in a safe spot.
 - Remember to use projectiles before engaging monsters in close combat.
 - Learn when to run away from things you can't handle - this is important!
   It is often wise to skip a dangerous level. But don't overdo this.

DEATH
-----

Before long, you'll probably end up dead.

Death in Crawl is permanent; you cannot just reload a saved game and start
again where you left off. The `S` (save) command exists only to let you leave
a game part-way through and come back to it later. Quitting (`Ctrl-Q`) lets
you abandon a character if you can't even be bothered to help them escape alive.

Well, that's it for the quick-start guide. This should help you through your
first few games, but Crawl is extremely (some would say excessively) complex
and cannot be adequately described in so short a document. So when you feel
ready to start playing with magic, skills, and religions, browse the manual.

Happy Crawling!

Crawl 快速入门
================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


不想先读手册，想直接开始玩 Crawl？这份指南会帮你以最少的准备开始冒险。

建议把它打印出来，在最初几局游戏中边玩边参考。游戏中连续按两次 `?`，
也能查看命令列表。还应试试教程模式，只需几分钟。

有空时，可以阅读 docs/ 目录中的 `crawl_manual.txt`，了解更详细的信息。

CRAWL 简介
------------

Crawl 是一款规模庞大、随机性很强的地下探索游戏。这个奇幻世界充满魔法，
也时常充斥暴力。你的任务是深入每局都不相同的地下城，取回佐特宝珠。

Crawl 是 `rogue-like` 类型的角色扮演游戏，是 Rogue 的后继者之一。
画面虽然简单，却信息丰富，力求一目了然；操作大多只需按一个键。

开始游戏
----------

启动程序后，会先询问你的名字。不必花太多时间，因为你的第一个角色
**不会**活得很久（抱歉，但这是事实）。

接下来从菜单选择种族和背景。山地矮人、弥诺陶洛斯或巨魔战士都不错。
精灵比较脆弱，人类各方面都很平均，更奇异的种族则大多不适合新手。
最后，可能还需要选择武器。推荐斧头，因为斧头很好玩。

现在你进入游戏了。游戏画面分为三个部分：

 - 地图位于屏幕左上方。正中央的 `@`（或角色图标）代表你。
   明亮部分是当前能看到的区域；曾去过、现在看不到的地方则会变暗。
 - 消息区位于地图下方，占据较大空间。它会叙述事件，并不时询问你。
 - 状态区位于地图右侧，显示生命、能力等各种指标。

探索
------

试着用数字键盘（可尝试开关 Numlock），或 Rogue 的 `hjklyubn` 键移动。
按 `o` 会启动自动探索，持续移动，直到看见敌人或发生其他值得注意的事件，
例如发现楼梯。

想知道屏幕上某个字符代表什么，可以按 `x` 查看简述，再按 `v` 阅读详情。
用 `O`、`C` 开门或关门，用 `<` 上楼、`>` 下楼。

地下城越深，越危险，也越有趣！迷路时可按 `X` 打开占满屏幕的楼层地图。

物品
------

走一会儿，你一定会发现地上的物品，也可能遇见怪物；应对怪物的方法见后文。
用 `g` 或 `,` 拾取，用 `d` 丢弃，用 `i` 查看携带物品。
在背包中按物品对应的键，可以查看详情和可用操作。

物品主要分为以下几类：

 - **武器**以 `)` 表示。按 `w` 持用。
 - **防具**以 `[` 表示。按 `W` 穿上或脱下。
   越重的防具通常防护越好，但可能妨碍闪避、施法或远程武器射击。
 - **弹药**以 `(` 表示。用 `f` 和 `F` 投射。
 - **魔杖**（`/`）、**卷轴**（`?`）和**药水**（`!`）可能非常有价值，
   但使用次数有限：卷轴和药水各只能使用一次，魔杖则只有一定次数的充能。
   按 `V` 唤发魔杖，按 `r` 阅读卷轴，按 `q` 喝药水。
   最初你不知道卷轴或药水的效果，只能看到外观描述。
   例如使用过一瓶治疗药水后，以后就能认出所有治疗药水。
 - **戒指**（`=`）和**护身符**（`"`）提供各种效果，大多有益。
   用 `P` 戴上，用 `R` 摘下。
 - **金币**（`$`）可以在商店购物。

还有一些其他物品类型，你会在游戏中逐渐发现。

怪物
------

你也会遇见怪物，大多用字母表示。朝怪物所在方格移动，就会攻击它。
按 Tab 会自动靠近并攻击附近怪物。

受伤时，你会损失生命值，显示在状态列表上方附近。
生命值会随时间自然恢复；生命耗尽，你就会死亡。

要活下去，你需要掌握一些基本战术：

 - 战斗之间要休息。`s`、`.`、Delete 或数字键盘 5 可休息一回合；
   按 `5` 或 Shift 加数字键盘 5 可长时间休息，完全恢复后会停止。
 - 尽量不要同时与多只怪物作战。退入走廊，让它们只能逐一与你交战。
 - 死后，卷轴和药水等消耗品就帮不上忙了。多数消耗品在艰难战斗开始时
   使用，比濒死时才用更有效。可以在安全处“浪费”同一叠中的一个来提前鉴定。
 - 与怪物近战前，记得先用投射物攻击。
 - 学会在无法应付时逃跑，这一点很重要！跳过危险楼层往往是明智之举，
   但也别过分依赖这种做法。

死亡
------

过不了多久，你大概就会死去。

Crawl 中的死亡是永久的，不能重新载入存档，从原处再来。
`S` 保存命令只是为了让你中途离开，以后继续同一局游戏。
如果连帮角色逃生都不想费心了，可以用 `Ctrl-Q` 放弃角色。

快速入门到此结束。它应该能帮你度过最初几局，但 Crawl 极其复杂，
有人甚至觉得复杂过头，无法用这么短的文档说清楚。
准备开始尝试魔法、技能和信仰时，请翻阅手册。

祝你冒险愉快！

 - **武器**以 `)` 表示。按 `w` 持用。
 - **防具**以 `[` 表示。按 `W` 穿上或脱下。
   越重的防具通常防护越好，但可能妨碍闪避、施法或远程武器射击。
 - **弹药**以 `(` 表示。用 `f` 和 `F` 投射。
 - **魔杖**（`/`）、**卷轴**（`?`）和**药水**（`!`）可能非常有价值，
   但使用次数有限：卷轴和药水各只能使用一次，魔杖则只有一定次数的充能。
   按 `V` 唤发魔杖，按 `r` 阅读卷轴，按 `q` 喝药水。
   最初你不知道卷轴或药水的效果，只能看到外观描述。
   例如使用过一瓶治疗药水后，以后就能认出所有治疗药水。
 - **戒指**（`=`）和**护身符**（`"`）提供各种效果，大多有益。
   用 `P` 戴上，用 `R` 摘下。
 - **金币**（`$`）可以在商店购物。

还有一些其他物品类型，你会在游戏中逐渐发现。

怪物
------

你也会遇见怪物，大多用字母表示。朝怪物所在方格移动，就会攻击它。
按 Tab 会自动靠近并攻击附近怪物。

受伤时，你会损失生命值，显示在状态列表上方附近。
生命值会随时间自然恢复；生命耗尽，你就会死亡。

要活下去，你需要掌握一些基本战术：

 - 战斗之间要休息。`s`、`.`、Delete 或数字键盘 5 可休息一回合；
   按 `5` 或 Shift 加数字键盘 5 可长时间休息，完全恢复后会停止。
 - 尽量不要同时与多只怪物作战。退入走廊，让它们只能逐一与你交战。
 - 死后，卷轴和药水等消耗品就帮不上忙了。多数消耗品在艰难战斗开始时
   使用，比濒死时才用更有效。可以在安全处“浪费”同一叠中的一个来提前鉴定。
 - 与怪物近战前，记得先用投射物攻击。
 - 学会在无法应付时逃跑，这一点很重要！跳过危险楼层往往是明智之举，
   但也别过分依赖这种做法。

死亡
------

过不了多久，你大概就会死去。

Crawl 中的死亡是永久的，不能重新载入存档，从原处再来。
`S` 保存命令只是为了让你中途离开，以后继续同一局游戏。
如果连帮角色逃生都不想费心了，可以用 `Ctrl-Q` 放弃角色。

快速入门到此结束。它应该能帮你度过最初几局，但 Crawl 极其复杂，
有人甚至觉得复杂过头，无法用这么短的文档说清楚。
准备开始尝试魔法、技能和信仰时，请翻阅手册。

祝你冒险愉快！

changes.english:
A: "Better" depends on a number of factors, such as your weapon skills, whether
it's one- or two-handed, the randart properties, the weapon brand, and the
monsters you're about to face. In general, switching from a weapon type at
which you are already highly skilled to another one that you have no skill in
is a waste of time. The brands may greatly differ in damage output, but you can
get a good idea by bashing a few comparatively harmless monsters with each and
comparing the results.

The delay in swinging a weapon can be reduced by the corresponding weapon skill.
You can view your delay and damage rating with a weapon by reading its
description or pressing '@' while the weapon is equipped. '@' works while
unarmed too.
changes.before:

changes.english:
<h>Searching the stash-tracker</h>

You can search for items and dungeon features by name (or a substring of the
name). In the list of search results, you can select a search result by its
hotkey to travel to its location.

Some examples of search strings:
<w>mutation</w>      find all potions of mutation, including potions in shops.
<w>throwing net</w>  finds every single throwing net and piles of nets.
<w>shop</w>          lists all shops. Press <w>!</w> and a shop's letter for the stock.
<w>Lair:2</w>        find everything known to be on Lair:2.
<w>/D:[2-4]</w>      finds everything on Dungeon levels 2-4. Regexes are allowed!
              Note that /D:[3-10] will not work as intended, since [x-y] is a
              regex character range.
<w>rPois</w>         finds all items with an rPois resistance.
<w>rC++</w>          finds all items with an rC++ resistance.
<w>+3</w>            finds all items with a +3 enchantment.
<w>/Lair.*axe</w> and <w>axe && Lair</w> both show all axes in the Lair.

Some shortcuts:
<w>.</w>             lists everything on your current level.
<w>..</w>            lists all items you know.
<w>0</w> to <w>9</w>        lists all items at the specified waypoint.
<w>*</w>             lists all items at all waypoints.
<w>@<<query></w>      lists everything matching <<query> on your current level.
<w>/<<regex></w>      lists items matching <<regex> as a regular expression.
<w>=<<string></w>     lists items containing <<string> as a substring.

You can also examine shops and items in the search results by pressing <w>?</w> and
then selecting the hotkey for the search result. This will give a description
of the item or the contents of the shop.

The stash search string is case-insensitive.

<h>Searching by item properties:</h>

You can search for spell names (such as <w>Ignite Poison</w>) to find spellbooks
that contain the spell.

You can search for artefact item properties (such as <w>/prevents.*teleport</w>)
to find artefacts that have the property.

You can search by some additional item properties: <w>artefact</w> or
<w>artifact</w> will find identified artefacts, <w>ego</w> or <w>branded</w>
will find non-artefacts with a brand and unidentified items which may be
branded, <w>throwable</w> will find things you can throw, <w>dropped</w> will
find items you have dropped, <w>in_shop</w> will find items in shops, and (if
the autopickup_search option is enabled) <w>autopickup</w> will find items that
would be automatically picked up.

Skill names (such as <w>Polearms</w> or <w>Long Blades</w>) will find all weapons that
train that skill. You can also look for <w>melee weapon</w> and <w>ranged weapon</w>.

You can also search by item types such as <w>book</w> or <w>manual</w> or <w>jewellery</w>.
For armour slots, use <w>helmet</w> (all headgear), <w>gloves</w>, <w>shield</w>, and <w>body</w>.
Use <w>armour && !!body</w> to list all armour pieces except for body armour.

<h>Finding Dungeon Features:</h>

You can search for dungeon features by name: all shops will be found by a search
for <w>shop</w> (including shops that do not have "shop" in their name); other
dungeon features can also be found by name: <w>dispersal trap</w>, <w>altar</w>,
etc. You can also search for altars by deity name: <w>Zin</w>.

<h>Non-regex operators:</h>

You can use !! to negate a search string, && for a boolean AND, || for
boolean OR, and <<<< >> for grouping.

For instance, to find rings (jewellery) but not ring mail you could use:
<w>ring && !!mail</w>

Note that <w>/</w> and <w>=</w> apply to individual patterns, not the entire query:
you should search for <w>armour && /r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>, not
<w>/armour && r(C|F|Pois|Elec)</w>.

<h>Create specified monster</h>

To create a monster with the default equipment for its species, simply enter
the species name, such as <w>kobold</w> or <w>Yiuf</w>.

A hydra or slymdra can be given a specific number of heads by calling it an
n<w>-headed</w> <w>hydra</w> or n<w>-headed</w> <w>slymdra</w> (with a maximum of 20 heads):

<w>four-headed hydra</w>

To set the colour a (very) ugly thing takes when it is first created, use:

<w>white very ugly thing</w>

The valid colours are <w>brown</w>, <w>cyan</w>, <w>green</w>, <w>purple</w>, <w>red</w> and <w>white</w>.

A mutant beast can be customised by prefacing it with a maturity level and/or
hyphen-separated set of traits, as follows:

<w>mature shock-weird mutant beast</w>

The valid maturity levels are <w>larval</w>, <w>juvenile</w>, <w>mature</w>, <w>elder</w> and <w>primal</w>. The
facets are <w>sting</w>, <w>bat</w>, <w>fire</w>, <w>weird</w>, <w>shock</w> and <w>ox</w>.

A slime creature's size can be set to other than normal using the prefixes
<w>large</w>, <w>very large</w>, <w>enormous</w> or <w>titanic</w>:

<w>very large slime creature</w>

If a monster is a member of a band, you can request that it be eligible for
band members by adding the keyword <w>band</w> to the name. For instance:

<w>orc warlord band</w>

Specifying <w>band</w> doesn't force bands to be placed - it requests that the game
use the normal chances of creating a band. A band will only be placed if there
is space for it.

A monster can be given specific items by following the monster name with a
semi-colon and then with an item list. For example:

<w>orc ; rapier | quick blade . chain mail | plate armour</w>

will generate an orc wielding either a rapier or a quick blade and wearing
either chain mail or plate armour. Randarts and ego items are only generated
if they are explicitly requested. Note that any items that the monster was
originally generated with will be removed and destroyed. This can be used to
force a monster to have no items whatsoever:

<w>orc; nothing</w>

For further information, see <cyan>docs/develop/levels/syntax.txt</cyan>, section <cyan>ITEMS</cyan>.
Any reference to a slash (<w>/</w>) should be replaced with a pipe (<w>|</w>) and any comma
(<w>,</w>) with a full stop (<w>.</w>).

The same syntax is also used to create a specific type of dancing weapon:

<w>dancing weapon; rapier</w>

Limitations: If a monster is given a random launcher, there is no way to force
the ammo type to match the launcher type. As a special case, however, a
launcher dancing weapon is always generated with some suitable ammunition.

You can specify that a monster will always generate a corpse by using the tag
<w>always_corpse</w>, or that it will never generate a corpse with <w>never_corpse</w>.

By default, monsters are generated asleep. This is changed by prefixing the
name with <w>generate_awake</w>.

<w>generate_awake boulder beetle</w>

A prefix of <w>patrolling</w> prevents it from walking out of sight of the the place
where it was created.

You can set the monster's god using the <w>god</w>: specifier as follows:

<w>orc god:the_shining_one</w>

If the monster is to be a gift of the specified god, this should be suffixed
with <w>god_gift</w>:

<w>orc god:the_shining_one god_gift</w>

Note that the monster will not be considered a god gift unless <w>god_gift</w> is
explicitly set.

You can set the monster's faction by specifying <w>att</w>: one of:

* <w>att:hostile</w> -- the default
* <w>att:friendly</w> -- tame, will follow you
* <w>att:neutral</w> -- hostile to both you and att:hostile monsters
* <w>att:good_neutral</w> -- hostile to att:hostile
* <w>att:fellow_slime</w> -- tame, won't follow you

Monsters can be given colours that override their default colour:

<w>col:darkgrey fungus</w>

The colour <w>any</w> can be given, in which case a random colour will be chosen.

You can override the displayed monster tile using the <w>tile</w>: specifier as
follows:

<w>rat tile:mons_giant_bat</w>

In tiles version, this would create a monster that uses the "<cyan>mons_giant_bat</cyan>"
tile, but is otherwise identical to a rat. In ASCII mode, this will do
nothing.

If you want to place a random monster suitable for the level the map is
generated on, you can use

<w>random</w>

If you want to place a random monster suitable for some other place, you can
use a place: tag in the monster spec:

<w>place:Abyss</w>

Using <w>place</w>: implies that you want a random monster. You can also request
zombies from random monsters suitable for some other depth as (e.g.):

<w>place:Elf:3 zombie</w>

The available modifiers are <w>zombie</w>, <w>draugr</w>, <w>simulacrum</w>, and <w>spectre</w>.

<h>Overriding Monster Names</h>

Individual monsters can be given names as follows:

<w>kobold name:Durwent</w>

This will cause the monster to appear as "<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>". Spaces can be
placed in the name by substituting them with the _ symbol. It is worth noting
that "<cyan>the <<race></cyan>" will be appended to all names, which should be considered
when coming up with them.

There are three different modifiers that can be used on a name:
<w>name_adjective</w>, <w>name_suffix and </w>name_replace. <w>name_adjective</w> makes the
name act as an adjective. For example:

<w>kobold name:ugly name_adjective</w>

Will cause "<cyan>An ugly kobold</cyan>", "<cyan>The ugly kobold hits you</cyan>", and so on.

<w>name_suffix</w> does the same, but after the monster's base name:

<w>kobold name:wearing_mittens name_suffix</w>

Will give "<cyan>A kobold wearing mittens</cyan>", "<cyan>The kobold wearing mittens hits you</cyan>",
and so on.

<w>name_replace</w> causes the base name to be replaced by given name, as if the
monster was a unique:

<w>kobold name:Durwent name_replace</w>

Will result in "<cyan>Durwent</cyan>" rather than "<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>". The corpse will
still be a "<cyan>kobold corpse of Durwent</cyan>".

<w>name_species</w> uses the name for corpses as-is, without prefixing it with
"<cyan>kobold</cyan> <cyan>corpse of X</cyan>" for <w>name_replace</w>. It also avoids the usual name tag
that displays above unique and renamed monsters in local tiles.

In combination with <w>name_replace</w> or <w>name_species</w>, there are two further tags
that can be used when renaming monsters, but not giving them an actual "name":
<w>name_descriptor</w>, and <w>name_definite</w>.

For example:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace</w>

Will result in "<cyan>goblin hits you</cyan>". However, adding <w>name_descriptor</w> from the
above flags will result in "<cyan>The goblin hits you</cyan>" and in the description of the
monster, "<cyan>A goblin</cyan>".

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor</w>

The <w>name_definite</w> flag ensures that it is never referred to as "<cyan>a</cyan>" or "<cyan>an</cyan>",
but that the definite object is always used. Therefore, you will see "<cyan>The
<cyan>goblin</cyan> <cyan>hits you</cyan>", as per above, but also "<cyan>The goblin</cyan>" in its description.
Setting <w>name_definite</w> will automatically set the flag <w>name_descriptor</w>,
therefore meaning that:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_definite</w>

is exactly the same as:

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor name_definite</w>

<w>name_zombie</w> can be used to redefine already zombified monsters (including
draugr, simulacra and spectrals).

Finally, <w>name_nocorpse</w> will cause the name to be completely ignored for
corpses. For example:

<w>wizard name:sad name_adjective name_nocorpse</w>

will result in "<cyan>a sad wizard</cyan>" that leaves "<cyan>a wizard corpse</cyan>".

For instances where space in definitions is limited, you can use abbreviated
forms of these tags:

* <w>name_suffix</w> -> <w>n_suf</w>
* <w>name_adjective</w> -> <w>n_adj</w>
* <w>name_replace</w> -> <w>n_rpl</w>
* <w>name_species</w> -> <w>n_spe</w>
* <w>name_descriptor</w> -> <w>n_des</w>
* <w>name_definite</w> -> <w>n_the</w>
* <w>name_zombie</w> -> <w>n_zom</w>
* <w>name_nocorpse</w> -> <w>n_noc</w>

<h>Overriding Monster Stats</h>

Further monster customisation can be made by using <w>hd</w> and <w>hp</w>. These two tags
allow you to completely overwrite the original hit dice and hit points of a
monster:

<w>kobold hd:20</w>

Creates a kobold with a hit dice of 20. As its hp is randomised, based on its
hit dice, this will also be re-rolled. Monsters with a specific hit point
value will not have this value change.

You can also have a specific value for hit points:

<w>kobold hp:20</w>

Creates a kobold with 20 hit points. This is also useful for monsters (such as
statues) which come with non-randomised HP values.

Monsters can be marked as summoned by using <w>dur</w> and <w>sum</w> tags. The <w>dur</w> tag
accepts an integer between 1 and 6 inclusive. The <w>sum</w> tag accepts the name of
a spell (parsed as per the <w>spells</w> tag, described below) or any of <w>clone</w>
(Rakshasa), <w>animate</w> (from animate dead), <w>chaos</w> (made from pure chaos), <w>miscast</w>
(summoned from by spell miscast effect), <w>zot</w> (summoned by a Zot trap), <w>wrath</w>
(summoned by a god in an act of retribution), <w>aid</w> (summoned by a god in order
to give aid).

Of the spells, <w>shadow_creatures</w> has the most significant effect, in that
monsters will dissipate into the shadows rather than disappear in a puff of
smoke. Using non-summoning spells will also have no effect.

Tagging a monster with <w>seen</w> will override the system and force that monster to
be marked as already viewed; this means that it won't generate messages such
as "<cyan>A kobold comes into view</cyan>".

<h>Overriding Monster Spells</h>

Monster spell sets can be overridden with a <w>spells</w>: tag, used as follows:

*<w>goblin spells:throw_flame.50.wizard</w>
*<w>ancient lich spells:symbol_of_torment.26.wizard; glaciate.51.wizard</w>

(a list of spell slots, consisting of a spell name with spaces replaced with
underscores, a frequency of casting and set of spell slot flags specified
afterwards with <w>.</w>, with slots separated by <w>;</w>. There should be no spaces around
the <w>;</w> or after the <w>spells</w>: prefix)

Spell names must exactly match the names in <cyan>spl-data.h</cyan>, with spaces replaced
by underscores. Spell frequencies are an (x in 200) chance that that spell
will be cast. Spell flags include:

* <w>natural</w>, <w>magical</w>, <w>demonic</w>, <w>wizard</w>, or <w>priest</w> - the manner in which this
spell is being cast. Wizards and priests can be silenced and will trigger
appropriate conducts (Trog will appreciate killing wizards, Beogh will
appreciate killing priests). Magical, demonic, and wizard spells are subject
to anti-magic effects. Natural spells do not generate noise.
* <w>emergency</w> - the monster will only cast the spell when low on health.
* <w>breath</w> - the spell is a breath weapon, and using it triggers a breath
timeout during which the spell cannot be cast again.
* <w>no_silent</w> - the spell cannot be used while silent, even if it is an ability
type normally not subject to silence.
* <w>instant</w> - the spell does not expend the monster's energy; they may take
another action on the same turn.
* <w>noisy</w> - forces the spell to make noise even if it is a natural ability.

You may use <w>none</w> specify that a slot should be left empty. You can force a
spell-less monster with:

<w>orc wizard spells:none</w>

<h>Setting enchantments</h>

You may give a monster any number of enchantments. It may start hasted, blind,
have permanent RMsl, etc. The syntax is <w>ench:<<name>:<<duration>:<<degree></w> or
<w>perm_ench:<<name>:<<degree></w>. The <w><<degree></w> and <w><<duration></w> fields may be
omitted.

For example:

* <w>orc perm_ench:blind perm_ench:mad</w>
* <w>dream sheep ench:sticky_flame</w>
* <w>stone giant dur:1 ench:berserk</w>

<w>col:darkgrey fungus</w>

可以指定颜色 <w>any</w>，此时会随机选择颜色。

使用 <w>tile</w>: 指定显示的怪物图块，例如：

<w>rat tile:mons_giant_bat</w>

在图块版中，这会创建一个使用“<cyan>mons_giant_bat</cyan>”图块、其他方面与老鼠完全相同的怪物。在 ASCII 模式下则没有效果。

要生成适合地图所在楼层的随机怪物，可以使用：

<w>random</w>

要生成适合其他地点的随机怪物，可以在怪物定义中使用 place: 标签：

<w>place:Abyss</w>

可用修饰词为 <w>zombie</w>、<w>draugr</w>、<w>simulacrum</w> 和 <w>spectre</w>。

<h>覆盖怪物名称</h>

可以为单个怪物命名，例如：

<w>kobold name:Durwent</w>

这会让怪物显示为“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。名称中的空格可以用 _ 代替。命名时请注意，所有名称后都会添加“<cyan>the <<race></cyan>”。

名称可用三种不同的修饰词：<w>name_adjective</w>、<w>name_suffix and </w>name_replace。<w>name_adjective</w> 使名称充当形容词。例如：

<w>kobold name:ugly name_adjective</w>

这会生成“<cyan>An ugly kobold</cyan>”“<cyan>The ugly kobold hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_suffix</w> 作用相似，但位于怪物基础名称之后：

<w>kobold name:wearing_mittens name_suffix</w>

这会生成“<cyan>A kobold wearing mittens</cyan>”“<cyan>The kobold wearing mittens hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_replace</w> 用指定名称替代基础名称，就像独特怪物一样：

<w>kobold name:Durwent name_replace</w>

结果会是“<cyan>Durwent</cyan>”，而非“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。其尸体仍会是“<cyan>kobold corpse of Durwent</cyan>”。

<w>name_species</w> 会让尸体直接使用该名称；对于 <w>name_replace</w>，不再添加“<cyan>kobold</cyan> <cyan>corpse of X</cyan>”前缀。它还会隐藏本地图块版中通常显示在独特怪物与改名怪物上方的名称标签。

与 <w>name_replace</w> 或 <w>name_species</w> 配合时，还有两个标签可用于修改称呼方式，而不赋予实际“姓名”：<w>name_descriptor</w> 与 <w>name_definite</w>。

例如：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace</w>

这会生成“<cyan>goblin hits you</cyan>”。但加入上述 <w>name_descriptor</w> 标记后，会生成“<cyan>The goblin hits you</cyan>”，怪物说明中则显示“<cyan>A goblin</cyan>”。

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor</w>

<w>name_definite</w> 保证称呼永远不使用“<cyan>a</cyan>”或“<cyan>an</cyan>”，而始终使用定冠词。因此，除了上述“<cyan>The
<cyan>goblin</cyan> <cyan>hits you</cyan>”，说明中也会显示“<cyan>The goblin</cyan>”。设置 <w>name_definite</w> 会自动设置 <w>name_descriptor</w>，因此：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_definite</w>

与以下写法完全相同：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor name_definite</w>

<w>name_zombie</w> 可用于重新定义已经亡灵化的怪物，包括尸鬼、冰像及幽灵。

最后，<w>name_nocorpse</w> 会让尸体完全忽略该名称。例如：

<w>wizard name:sad name_adjective name_nocorpse</w>

这会生成“<cyan>a sad wizard</cyan>”，留下的则是“<cyan>a wizard corpse</cyan>”。

如果定义空间有限，可以使用这些标签的缩写：

* <w>name_suffix</w> -> <w>n_suf</w>
* <w>name_adjective</w> -> <w>n_adj</w>
* <w>name_replace</w> -> <w>n_rpl</w>
* <w>name_species</w> -> <w>n_spe</w>
* <w>name_descriptor</w> -> <w>n_des</w>
* <w>name_definite</w> -> <w>n_the</w>
* <w>name_zombie</w> -> <w>n_zom</w>
* <w>name_nocorpse</w> -> <w>n_noc</w>

<h>覆盖怪物属性</h>

使用 <w>hd</w> 与 <w>hp</w> 可以进一步自定义怪物，完全覆盖其原有生命骰与生命值：

<w>kobold hd:20</w>

这会创建生命骰为 20 的狗头人。由于生命值依据生命骰随机生成，其生命值也会重新随机。具有固定生命值的怪物则不会因此改变生命值。

也可以指定确切的生命值：

<w>kobold hp:20</w>

这会创建生命值为 20 的狗头人。对于生命值不随机的怪物，例如雕像，这也很有用。

使用 <w>dur</w> 与 <w>sum</w> 标签可以将怪物标记为召唤物。<w>dur</w> 接受 1 至 6（含两端）的整数。<w>sum</w> 接受法术名（按下述 <w>spells</w> 标签的规则解析），或以下任一值：<w>clone</w>（罗刹的复制体）、<w>animate</w>（操纵死尸）、<w>chaos</w>（纯混沌构成）、<w>miscast</w>（施法失误效果召来）、<w>zot</w>（佐特陷阱召来）、<w>wrath</w>（神祇为惩戒而召来）、<w>aid</w>（神祇为援助而召来）。

法术中，<w>shadow_creatures</w> 的效果最显著：怪物会散入阴影，而非化为烟雾消失。使用非召唤法术则不会产生这类效果。

使用 <w>seen</w> 标记，会强制将怪物设为已经见过，因此不会出现“<cyan>A kobold comes into view</cyan>”等消息。

<h>覆盖怪物法术</h>

使用 <w>spells</w>: 标签可以覆盖怪物法术组，例如：

*<w>goblin spells:throw_flame.50.wizard</w>
*<w>ancient lich spells:symbol_of_torment.26.wizard; glaciate.51.wizard</w>

（这里是一组法术槽。每个槽由法术名、施放频率及法术槽标记构成；名称中的空格用下划线替换，后续字段以 <w>.</w> 分隔，各槽以 <w>;</w> 分隔。<w>;</w> 两侧及 <w>spells</w>: 前缀之后都不应有空格。）

法术名必须与 <cyan>spl-data.h</cyan> 中的名称完全匹配，并将空格替换为下划线。施放频率表示每次以 x/200 的概率施展该法术。法术标记包括：

* <w>natural</w>、<w>magical</w>、<w>demonic</w>、<w>wizard</w> 或 <w>priest</w> -- 指定施放方式。巫师和祭司可被沉默，并触发相应神祇行为判定：特洛戈赞赏击杀巫师，比欧弗赞赏击杀祭司。魔法、恶魔和巫师法术受反魔法影响。自然能力不制造噪声。
* <w>emergency</w> -- 怪物只在生命值较低时施展此法术。
* <w>breath</w> -- 该法术是吐息武器；使用后会进入一段无法再次施展的吐息冷却时间。
* <w>no_silent</w> -- 沉默时无法使用，即使这种能力通常不受沉默影响。
* <w>instant</w> -- 不消耗怪物行动能量，因此它可以在同一回合再次行动。
* <w>noisy</w> -- 强制法术制造噪声，即使它是自然能力。

使用 <w>none</w> 可以指定空法术槽。要强制怪物没有任何法术，可使用：

<w>orc wizard spells:none</w>

<h>设置附魔状态</h>

你可以赋予怪物任意数量的附魔状态，例如生成时加速、失明或永久偏转投射物。语法为 <w>ench:<<name>:<<duration>:<<degree></w> 或 <w>perm_ench:<<name>:<<degree></w>。<w><<degree></w> 与 <w><<duration></w> 字段可以省略。

例如：

* <w>orc perm_ench:blind perm_ench:mad</w>
* <w>dream sheep ench:sticky_flame</w>
* <w>stone giant dur:1 ench:berserk</w>
changes.after:
<h>创建指定怪物</h>

若要创建携带其种族默认装备的怪物，只需输入种族名称，例如 <w>kobold</w> 或 <w>Yiuf</w>。

可以用 n<w>-headed</w> <w>hydra</w> 或 n<w>-headed</w> <w>slymdra</w> 指定多头蛇或黏液多头蛇的头数，最多 20 个头：

<w>four-headed hydra</w>

要指定丑陋怪或极丑陋怪刚生成时的颜色，请使用：

<w>white very ugly thing</w>

有效颜色为 <w>brown</w>、<w>cyan</w>、<w>green</w>、<w>purple</w>、<w>red</w> 和 <w>white</w>。

可以在名称前添加成熟程度，以及用连字符分隔的特征组，来自定义变异兽：

<w>mature shock-weird mutant beast</w>

有效成熟程度为 <w>larval</w>、<w>juvenile</w>、<w>mature</w>、<w>elder</w> 和 <w>primal</w>。特征为 <w>sting</w>、<w>bat</w>、<w>fire</w>、<w>weird</w>、<w>shock</w> 和 <w>ox</w>。

使用 <w>large</w>、<w>very large</w>、<w>enormous</w> 或 <w>titanic</w> 前缀，可将黏液生物设为非普通体型：

<w>very large slime creature</w>

如果怪物属于某个怪物群，可以在名称后添加 <w>band</w>，请求按通常规则为它生成同群成员。例如：

<w>orc warlord band</w>

指定 <w>band</w> 并不强制生成怪物群，而是请求使用正常概率。只有空间足够时才会放置怪物群。

在怪物名后添加分号，再列出物品，可以指定怪物携带的物品。例如：

<w>orc ; rapier | quick blade . chain mail | plate armour</w>

这会生成一个持有西洋剑或快剑、穿着链甲或板甲的兽人。只有明确指定时，才会生成随机神器或带词缀物品。怪物原本生成的所有物品都会被移除并摧毁；因此也可以用它强制怪物不携带任何物品：

<w>orc; nothing</w>

更多信息见 <cyan>docs/develop/levels/syntax.txt</cyan> 的 <cyan>ITEMS</cyan> 章节。其中出现的斜杠（<w>/</w>）应换成竖线（<w>|</w>），逗号（<w>,</w>）应换成句点（<w>.</w>）。

同一语法也用于创建指定种类的舞动武器：

<w>dancing weapon; rapier</w>

限制：如果给怪物随机远程发射武器，就无法强制弹药类型与之匹配。不过，远程舞动武器是特例，总会附带一些合适的弹药。

使用 <w>always_corpse</w> 可以指定怪物必定留下尸体，使用 <w>never_corpse</w> 则指定它绝不留下尸体。

怪物默认以睡眠状态生成。给名称添加 <w>generate_awake</w> 前缀可改变这一点。

<w>generate_awake boulder beetle</w>

添加 <w>patrolling</w> 前缀，可防止怪物走出其生成地点的视野范围。

使用 <w>god</w>: 指定怪物信奉的神祇，例如：

<w>orc god:the_shining_one</w>

如果怪物应当是指定神祇的恩赐，还需要添加 <w>god_gift</w> 后缀：

<w>orc god:the_shining_one god_gift</w>

注意：除非明确设置了 <w>god_gift</w>，否则怪物不会被视为神赐。

使用 <w>att</w>: 指定怪物的阵营，可选值为：

* <w>att:hostile</w> -- 默认状态
* <w>att:friendly</w> -- 驯服，会跟随你
* <w>att:neutral</w> -- 敌视你及 att:hostile 怪物
* <w>att:good_neutral</w> -- 敌视 att:hostile 怪物
* <w>att:fellow_slime</w> -- 驯服，但不会跟随你

可以给怪物指定颜色，以覆盖其默认颜色：

<w>col:darkgrey fungus</w>

可以指定颜色 <w>any</w>，此时会随机选择颜色。

使用 <w>tile</w>: 指定显示的怪物图块，例如：

<w>rat tile:mons_giant_bat</w>

在图块版中，这会创建一个使用“<cyan>mons_giant_bat</cyan>”图块、其他方面与老鼠完全相同的怪物。在 ASCII 模式下则没有效果。

要生成适合地图所在楼层的随机怪物，可以使用：

<w>random</w>

要生成适合其他地点的随机怪物，可以在怪物定义中使用 place: 标签：

<w>place:Abyss</w>

使用 <w>place</w>: 就意味着请求随机怪物。也可以请求从适合其他深度的随机怪物生成僵尸，例如：

<w>place:Elf:3 zombie</w>

可用修饰词为 <w>zombie</w>、<w>draugr</w>、<w>simulacrum</w> 和 <w>spectre</w>。

<h>覆盖怪物名称</h>

可以为单个怪物命名，例如：

<w>kobold name:Durwent</w>

这会让怪物显示为“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。名称中的空格可以用 _ 代替。命名时请注意，所有名称后都会添加“<cyan>the <<race></cyan>”。

名称可用三种不同的修饰词：<w>name_adjective</w>、<w>name_suffix and </w>name_replace。<w>name_adjective</w> 使名称充当形容词。例如：

<w>kobold name:ugly name_adjective</w>

这会生成“<cyan>An ugly kobold</cyan>”“<cyan>The ugly kobold hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_suffix</w> 作用相似，但位于怪物基础名称之后：

<w>kobold name:wearing_mittens name_suffix</w>

这会生成“<cyan>A kobold wearing mittens</cyan>”“<cyan>The kobold wearing mittens hits you</cyan>”等表达。

<w>name_replace</w> 用指定名称替代基础名称，就像独特怪物一样：

<w>kobold name:Durwent name_replace</w>

结果会是“<cyan>Durwent</cyan>”，而非“<cyan>Durwent the kobold</cyan>”。其尸体仍会是“<cyan>kobold corpse of Durwent</cyan>”。

<w>name_species</w> 会让尸体直接使用该名称；对于 <w>name_replace</w>，不再添加“<cyan>kobold</cyan> <cyan>corpse of X</cyan>”前缀。它还会隐藏本地图块版中通常显示在独特怪物与改名怪物上方的名称标签。

与 <w>name_replace</w> 或 <w>name_species</w> 配合时，还有两个标签可用于修改称呼方式，而不赋予实际“姓名”：<w>name_descriptor</w> 与 <w>name_definite</w>。

例如：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace</w>

这会生成“<cyan>goblin hits you</cyan>”。但加入上述 <w>name_descriptor</w> 标记后，会生成“<cyan>The goblin hits you</cyan>”，怪物说明中则显示“<cyan>A goblin</cyan>”。

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor</w>

<w>name_definite</w> 保证称呼永远不使用“<cyan>a</cyan>”或“<cyan>an</cyan>”，而始终使用定冠词。因此，除了上述“<cyan>The
<cyan>goblin</cyan> <cyan>hits you</cyan>”，说明中也会显示“<cyan>The goblin</cyan>”。设置 <w>name_definite</w> 会自动设置 <w>name_descriptor</w>，因此：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_definite</w>

与以下写法完全相同：

<w>kobold name:goblin name_replace name_descriptor name_definite</w>

<w>name_zombie</w> 可用于重新定义已经亡灵化的怪物，包括尸鬼、冰像及幽灵。

最后，<w>name_nocorpse</w> 会让尸体完全忽略该名称。例如：

<w>wizard name:sad name_adjective name_nocorpse</w>

这会生成“<cyan>a sad wizard</cyan>”，留下的则是“<cyan>a wizard corpse</cyan>”。

如果定义空间有限，可以使用这些标签的缩写：

* <w>name_suffix</w> -> <w>n_suf</w>
* <w>name_adjective</w> -> <w>n_adj</w>
* <w>name_replace</w> -> <w>n_rpl</w>
* <w>name_species</w> -> <w>n_spe</w>
* <w>name_descriptor</w> -> <w>n_des</w>
* <w>name_definite</w> -> <w>n_the</w>
* <w>name_zombie</w> -> <w>n_zom</w>
* <w>name_nocorpse</w> -> <w>n_noc</w>

<h>覆盖怪物属性</h>

使用 <w>hd</w> 与 <w>hp</w> 可以进一步自定义怪物，完全覆盖其原有生命骰与生命值：

<w>kobold hd:20</w>

这会创建生命骰为 20 的狗头人。由于生命值依据生命骰随机生成，其生命值也会重新随机。具有固定生命值的怪物则不会因此改变生命值。

也可以指定确切的生命值：

<w>kobold hp:20</w>

这会创建生命值为 20 的狗头人。对于生命值不随机的怪物，例如雕像，这也很有用。

使用 <w>dur</w> 与 <w>sum</w> 标签可以将怪物标记为召唤物。<w>dur</w> 接受 1 至 6（含两端）的整数。<w>sum</w> 接受法术名（按下述 <w>spells</w> 标签的规则解析），或以下任一值：<w>clone</w>（罗刹的复制体）、<w>animate</w>（操纵死尸）、<w>chaos</w>（纯混沌构成）、<w>miscast</w>（施法失误效果召来）、<w>zot</w>（佐特陷阱召来）、<w>wrath</w>（神祇为惩戒而召来）、<w>aid</w>（神祇为援助而召来）。

法术中，<w>shadow_creatures</w> 的效果最显著：怪物会散入阴影，而非化为烟雾消失。使用非召唤法术则不会产生这类效果。

使用 <w>seen</w> 标记，会强制将怪物设为已经见过，因此不会出现“<cyan>A kobold comes into view</cyan>”等消息。

<h>覆盖怪物法术</h>

使用 <w>spells</w>: 标签可以覆盖怪物法术组，例如：

*<w>goblin spells:throw_flame.50.wizard</w>
*<w>ancient lich spells:symbol_of_torment.26.wizard; glaciate.51.wizard</w>

（这里是一组法术槽。每个槽由法术名、施放频率及法术槽标记构成；名称中的空格用下划线替换，后续字段以 <w>.</w> 分隔，各槽以 <w>;</w> 分隔。<w>;</w> 两侧及 <w>spells</w>: 前缀之后都不应有空格。）

法术名必须与 <cyan>spl-data.h</cyan> 中的名称完全匹配，并将空格替换为下划线。施放频率表示每次以 x/200 的概率施展该法术。法术标记包括：

* <w>natural</w>、<w>magical</w>、<w>demonic</w>、<w>wizard</w> 或 <w>priest</w> -- 指定施放方式。巫师和祭司可被沉默，并触发相应神祇行为判定：特洛戈赞赏击杀巫师，比欧弗赞赏击杀祭司。魔法、恶魔和巫师法术受反魔法影响。自然能力不制造噪音。
* <w>emergency</w> -- 怪物只在生命值较低时施展此法术。
* <w>breath</w> -- 该法术是吐息武器；使用后会进入一段无法再次施展的吐息冷却时间。
* <w>no_silent</w> -- 沉默时无法使用，即使这种能力通常不受沉默影响。
* <w>instant</w> -- 不消耗怪物行动能量，因此它可以在同一回合再次行动。
* <w>noisy</w> -- 强制法术制造噪音，即使它是自然能力。

使用 <w>none</w> 可以指定空法术槽。要强制怪物没有任何法术，可使用：

<w>orc wizard spells:none</w>

<h>设置附魔状态</h>

你可以赋予怪物任意数量的附魔状态，例如生成时加速、失明或永久偏转投射物。语法为 <w>ench:<<name>:<<duration>:<<degree></w> 或 <w>perm_ench:<<name>:<<degree></w>。<w><<degree></w> 与 <w><<duration></w> 字段可以省略。

例如：

* <w>orc perm_ench:blind perm_ench:mad</w>
* <w>dream sheep ench:sticky_flame</w>
* <w>stone giant dur:1 ench:berserk</w>

changes.english:

twins were cast down, the good gods reduced their former realm to salt, that
such a terrible cult would never rise again. Amidst the ruins, only the last
cultists of the dead gods, their heretical constructs, and the guardians
of the cult's legendary treasure yet remain.

changes.english:
A ziggurat is a strange tower constructed of incrementally larger combat
arenas, each containing greater wealth and even greater danger than the last.

神塔是一座奇异高塔，每层的战斗场地都比上一层更大，财富更多，危险也更甚。请小心，这里容不得胆怯：即使最勇敢、最娴熟的冒险者，也曾在此丧命。每层都有通往安全地带的出口，但离开之后便无法重新进入。

地底保证会出现一座神塔。传说每座神塔底层都有一件魔法物品，可以开启下一座神塔；据说古人灵庙底层也有这种物品。每当你从神塔最后一层离开、完成征服后，之后的神塔就会更危险，也更富饶。

changes.english:
The Realm of Zot is a region of the dungeon that is so terrifying, so full of
madness, frenzy and lunacy, that it has been locked securely against random
trespassers. Only the most demented adventurers would dare gather the required
keys, break the seal and penetrate deeper — all in the vain hope for a fabled
artefact no one has ever laid eyes on before.
changes.before: 佐特之境如此恐怖，充满狂乱、暴躁与癫狂，因此被严密封锁，阻止闲杂人等闯入。只有最疯癫的冒险者，才敢收集所需钥匙、打破封印、继续深入——全为徒劳追寻一件从来无人亲眼见过的传说神器。
changes.after: 佐特领域是地下城的一片区域。这里如此恐怖，充满狂乱、暴躁与癫狂，因此被严密封锁，阻止闲杂人等闯入。只有最疯癫的冒险者，才敢收集所需钥匙、打破封印、继续深入——全为徒劳追寻一件从来无人亲眼见过的传说神器。

changes.english:
The card depicts an extravagantly-dressed, masked figure dancing alone in a
vast room.

Drawing this card will summon a dancing weapon. Its quality, brand, and
friendliness are all affected by card power.
changes.before:
牌面上，一个衣着华丽、戴着面具的人独自在宽阔的房间里起舞。

抽出此牌，会召唤一把舞动武器。其品质、词缀与是否友好，都受卡牌威力影响。
changes.after:

抽出此牌，会召唤一把舞动武器。其品质、印记与是否友好，都受卡牌威力影响。

changes.english:
A cloud of volatile blastmotes. These explode on contact with flame or creatures.
The explosion is concussive, knocking adjacent creatures away.
changes.before: 一团不稳定的爆裂微粒。它们接触火焰或生物时会爆炸，爆炸产生的冲击波会将相邻生物击退。
changes.after: 一团不稳定爆炸微粒。它们接触火焰或生物时会爆炸，爆炸产生的冲击波会将相邻生物击退。

changes.english:
A cloud of countless tiny fragments of magnetised metal, still vibrating
slightly from a recent electrical discharge. They will function as an attractor
for the Magnavolt spell until they dissipate.
changes.before: 一团无数细小的磁化金属碎片，仍因刚才的放电而微微振动。消散之前，它们会成为磁电术（Magnavolt）的吸引目标。
changes.after: 一团无数细小的磁化金属碎片，仍因刚才的放电而微微振动。消散之前，它们会成为巨磁电涌（Magnavolt）的吸引目标。

changes.english:
The winds of a polar vortex. It will deal severe damage to anyone within it,
only partially mitigated by resistance to cold.
changes.before: 极地涡旋中的狂风。它会严重伤害身处其中的所有生物，寒冷抗性只能减轻部分伤害。
changes.after: 极地涡流中的狂风。它会严重伤害身处其中的所有生物，寒冷抗性只能减轻部分伤害。

changes.english:
A pile of assorted fruit, ranging from common dungeon staples like chokos and
snozzcumbers, to rarer treats such as apples and oranges. You already carry as
much food as you will ever need for this journey, but the occasional nibble
wouldn't hurt.

changes.english:
A portal leading to a bazaar, where itinerant merchants gather to sell their

一个通往集市的门户，行商聚集在那里出售商品。
他们永远不会在一个地方呆很长时间。

一个通往市集的门户，行商聚集在那里出售商品。

changes.english: A gate leading back to the dungeon.

changes.after: 一个返回地下城的大门。

changes.english:
A portal leading to a bazaar, where itinerant merchants gather to sell their
wares. They will wait for you, but once you get a chance to browse their
inventory, the merchants will depart in search of other customers.
changes.before:
一个通往集市的门户，行商聚集在那里出售商品。
他们会等你，但一旦你浏览过他们的存货，商家将出发寻找其他客户。

changes.english: A portal leading to a ziggurat.
changes.before: 一个通往金字塔的门户。
changes.after: 一个通往神塔的门户。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a gateway to the iron city of dis
changes.english: A gateway leading to the Iron City of Dis.
changes.before: 一个通往狄斯铁城的入口。
changes.after: 一个通往冥府铁城的入口。

changes.english:
A portal leading to a glacial chasm, far more dangerous than the icy caverns
found in the shallower reaches of the Dungeon. The archway is gradually melting
away.
changes.before: 一个通往冰川裂缝的门户，比地牢浅层的冰窟危险得多。拱门在渐渐融化。
changes.after: 一个通往冰川裂缝的门户，比地下城浅层的冰窟危险得多。拱门在渐渐融化。

changes.english:
A staircase leading down to the grand vaults containing the silver rune of Zot,
whose wealth attracts the most powerful champions from across the Dungeon to its
defence.
changes.before: 一座通往下方宏伟宝库的楼梯，里面藏有佐特银色符文。宝库的财富吸引了地牢各处最强大的勇士前来守卫。
changes.after: 一座通往下方宏伟宝库的楼梯，里面藏有佐特银色符文。宝库的财富吸引了地下城各处最强大的勇士前来守卫。

changes.english:
A staircase leading up from the grand vaults containing the silver rune of Zot,
whose wealth attracts the most powerful champions from across the Dungeon to its
defence.
changes.before: 一座从宏伟宝库向上延伸的楼梯，宝库里面藏有佐特银色符文。那里的财富吸引了地牢各处最强大的勇士前来守卫。
changes.after: 一座从宏伟宝库向上延伸的楼梯，宝库里面藏有佐特银色符文。那里的财富吸引了地下城各处最强大的勇士前来守卫。

changes.english:
A wall of bluish-grey metal. As every dungeon electrician knows, it will ground
even magical bolts of lightning.
changes.before: 一面蓝灰色金属墙。地牢中的每个电工都知道，它甚至能让闪电箭接地。
changes.after: 一面蓝灰色金属墙。地下城中的每个电工都知道，它甚至能让闪电箭接地。

changes.english:
A sturdy metal cage, inscribed with cryptic magics. Whatever it once held -
whether person, beast, or experiment - was evidently already freed in response
to intruders like you infiltrating the Dungeon.
changes.before: 一个坚固的金属笼，上面刻着晦涩的魔法。不论它原本关着人、野兽还是试验品，显然都已为应付你这样的地牢入侵者而放了出来。
changes.after: 一个坚固的金属笼，上面刻着晦涩的魔法。不论它原本关着人、野兽还是试验品，显然都已为应付你这样的地下城入侵者而放了出来。

changes.english:
A large concealed net launcher hanging from the dungeon's ceiling. Enchanted by
the power of Zot, whenever an intelligent creature steps here - whether friend
or foe - the net will land only on you.
changes.before:
一个挂在地牢天花板上的巨大而隐蔽的网。
它被佐特注入魔力，每当有智慧生物来到这里——无论是敌是友——网只会落你身上。
changes.after:
一个挂在地下城天花板上的巨大而隐蔽的网。
它被佐特注入魔力，每当有智慧生物来到这里——无论是敌是友——网只会落你身上。

changes.english:
A magical trap which will displace anyone passing over it to a random place on
the same dungeon level.
changes.before: 这个魔力陷阱，任何经过它的人会被传送到这层地牢的一个随机地点。
changes.after: 这个魔力陷阱，任何经过它的人会被传送到这层地下城的一个随机地点。

changes.english:
A portal leading to one of many Necropolis repositories, where the freshly slain
and deeply resentful are sealed away. This wandering rift will eventually move
elsewhere to receive further dead.
changes.before: 一道通往死灵城众多收容所之一的传送门，那里封存着新死而满怀怨恨的亡者。这道游移的裂隙最终会转往别处，接纳更多死者。
changes.after: 一道通往亡者之城众多收容所之一的传送门，那里封存着新死而满怀怨恨的亡者。这道游移的裂隙最终会转往别处，接纳更多死者。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a portal to a secret trove of treasure
changes.english:
A portal leading to a treasure trove. This portal is unstable and will collapse
after a single use.
changes.before: 一道通往秘密宝藏库的传送门。它很不稳定，使用一次后便会崩塌。
changes.after: 一道通往秘藏的传送门。它很不稳定，使用一次后便会崩塌。

changes.english:
A door, covered in runic writing. It looks like there is something special
behind it — perhaps danger, perhaps treasure. You may break the runes by
opening it like any other door, but creatures of the dungeon will not dare
to try.
changes.before:
这扇门上满是符文记号。
门的后面应该有什么特别的东西——可能是危险，也可能是宝藏。
像打开其他门那样就能破坏符文，但地牢里的生物可不敢尝试。
changes.after:
这扇门上满是符文记号。
门的后面应该有什么特别的东西——可能是危险，也可能是宝藏。
像打开其他门那样就能破坏符文，但地下城里的生物可不敢尝试。

changes.english:
A door, covered in runic writing, made from magically translucent wood. It has
been created to seal away great danger or glorious treasure. You may break the
runes by opening it like any other door, but creatures of the dungeon will not
dare to try.
changes.before: 一扇布满符文、由魔法半透明木材制成的门。它被造来封住巨大的危险或珍贵的宝藏。你可以像开普通门一样破开符文，但地牢中的生物不敢尝试。
changes.after: 一扇布满符文、由魔法半透明木材制成的门。它被造来封住巨大的危险或珍贵的宝藏。你可以像开普通门一样破开符文，但地下城中的生物不敢尝试。

changes.english: A hole in the ground, leading to a dungeon level one or more floors deeper.
changes.before: 地面上的一个洞，通往更深一层或多层的地牢。
changes.after: 地面上的一个洞，通往更深一层或多层的地下城。

changes.english:
A shop in the dungeon, beyond sight of the world above, manned by a secretive
and reclusive shopkeeper who cannot be bargained with, grants no refunds, and
is interested in nothing you may have to sell. Some shops hawk antiques of
unknown provenance, and offer little hint as to the quality or nature of their
goods.
changes.before:
有一位神秘、隐居的商人在不见天日的地牢中开设了一家商店，
这里的商店不能还价，不会退款，而且也不会从你那里购买任何东西。
一些商店会出售来源不明的古物，店主自然不会告诉你这些商品的质量和性质。
changes.after:
有一位神秘、隐居的商人在不见天日的地下城中开设了一家商店，
这里的商店不能还价，不会退款，而且也不会从你那里购买任何东西。
一些商店会出售来源不明的古物，店主自然不会告诉你这些商品的质量和性质。

changes.english:
Bones are a common sight in the Dungeon, but skulls left impaled in a shrike's
manner on display send a more deliberate message to trespassers: the pike has
room for one more skull, and whoever set it up is happy to help relieve its
owner of theirs.
changes.before: 地牢里骨头很常见，但像伯劳鸟串猎物那样，把头骨刺在长枪上展示，是给闯入者更明确的警告：枪上还容得下一颗头骨，立枪者也很乐意帮它的主人摘下来。
changes.after: 地下城里骨头很常见，但像伯劳鸟串猎物那样，把头骨刺在长枪上展示，是给闯入者更明确的警告：枪上还容得下一颗头骨，立枪者也很乐意帮它的主人摘下来。

changes.english: A staircase leading back up to the familiarity of the dungeon.

changes.after: 一个返回你遇到过的地下城楼层的楼梯。

changes.english: A staircase leading back up to the Lair of Beasts.
changes.before: 一个返回兽穴的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个返回野兽巢穴的楼梯。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a staircase leading out of the dungeon
changes.english:
This staircase leads back out of the dungeon.

A staircase leading out of the dungeon. Climbing these stairs will end your
quest, whether you carry the Orb with you or not.
changes.before:
这个楼梯，穿过它能离开地牢。

这个楼梯是离开地牢的出口。爬上这些楼梯会结束你的探索，无论是否携带宝珠。
changes.after:
这个楼梯，穿过它能离开地下城。

这个楼梯是离开地下城的出口。爬上这些楼梯会结束你的探索，无论是否携带宝珠。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a staircase to the ecumenical temple
changes.english: A staircase leading to the Ecumenical Temple.
changes.before: 一个通往众神庙的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个通往众神殿的楼梯。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a staircase to the elven halls
changes.english: A staircase leading to the Elven Halls.
changes.before: 一个通往精灵殿堂的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个通往精灵大厅的楼梯。

changes.english: A staircase leading to the Lair of Beasts.
changes.before: 一个通往兽穴的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个通往野兽巢穴的楼梯。

changes.context: textdb:descript/features.txt:a staircase to the slime pits
changes.english: A staircase leading to the Slime Pits.
changes.before: 一个通往黏液坑洞的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个通往史莱姆巢穴的楼梯。

changes.english: A staircase leading to the Tomb of the Ancients.
changes.before: 一个通往坟冢的楼梯。
changes.after: 一个通往古人灵庙的楼梯。

changes.english:
A magical trap which will displace anyone passing over it to a random place on
the same dungeon level. It is worn with age, and will dissipate on use.
changes.before:
这个魔力陷阱，任何经过它的人会被传送到这层地牢的一个随机地点。
它会被消磨，一旦被激活就会消散。
changes.after:
这个魔力陷阱，任何经过它的人会被传送到这层地下城的一个随机地点。
它会被消磨，一旦被激活就会消散。

changes.english:
A one-way portal to another place on this level. When using a transporter,
adjacent allies and monsters will travel with you to the other side.
changes.before: 一道通往当前楼层其他位置的单向传送门。使用时，相邻的盟友与怪物都会与你一同前往另一端。
